name: btn-hover-top-flip
title: Top Flip Hover Button
blurb: Text flips upward to reveal coloured text from below.
description: A button with two text layers: a light one that flips up and out of view, and a dark one that flips up from below to replace it.
use_when: A CTA with smooth interactive motion.
a11y: Native button element. Duplicate text may confuse screen readers.
